faqs.question: What is Sandlot Picks Analytics?
faqs.answer: Sandlot Picks Analytics is a comprehensive MLB analytics platform that provides in-depth statistical analysis for players, teams, and league standings. We use advanced metrics and data visualization to help baseball fans and researchers better understand the game.

faqs.question: What can I do on this platform?
faqs.answer: You can explore detailed player statistics, analyze team performance across multiple categories, track MLB standings and division races, learn about baseball analytics through our educational resources, and stay informed with our Sandlot Insider articles.

faqs.question: Is Sandlot Picks free to use?
faqs.answer: Yes! Sandlot Picks offers free access to browse core content including MLB Standings, educational resources, our Glossary, and Sandlot Insider articles. Creating a free account unlocks additional features like Player Analytics and Team Analytics with detailed statistics.

faqs.question: Do I need to create an account?
faqs.answer: While you can browse some content without an account, creating a free account gives you access to our full analytics suite including Player Analytics and Team Analytics. For advanced features like predictions and premium UI tools, a paid subscription is required.

faqs.question: What access levels are available?
faqs.answer: We offer three tiers: (1) Guest Access - browse standings, glossary, articles, and educational content for free. (2) Free Account - unlock Player Analytics and Team Analytics with comprehensive statistics. (3) Premium - access predictions, advanced analytical tools, and premium features.

faqs.question: What's included in a free account?
faqs.answer: A free account gives you full access to Player Analytics with detailed batting and pitching stats, Team Analytics with offensive, pitching, and defensive breakdowns, historical data comparisons, and all educational resources.

faqs.question: What premium features are available?
faqs.answer: Premium subscribers get access to our prediction models, advanced analytical UI tools, enhanced data visualizations, and exclusive insights. These tools are designed for serious analysts and researchers who want the deepest level of baseball intelligence.

faqs.question: How do I search for a player?
faqs.answer: Navigate to the Player Analytics page and use the search bar at the top. You can search by player name to instantly access their complete statistical profile including batting, pitching, and advanced metrics. Note: Full Player Analytics requires a free account.

faqs.question: What statistics are available for players?
faqs.answer: We provide comprehensive player statistics including traditional metrics (AVG, HR, RBI, ERA, W-L), advanced metrics (wOBA, xFIP, BABIP, WAR), splits (vs LHP/RHP, home/away), and historical trends across multiple seasons.

faqs.question: Can I compare multiple players?
faqs.answer: Yes, our analytics tools allow you to view and compare statistics across different players. This helps you identify performance differences, trends, and how players stack up against each other.

faqs.question: How do I view team statistics?
faqs.answer: Go to Team Analytics and select any of the 30 MLB teams. You'll see comprehensive data including offensive stats, pitching metrics, defensive performance, and historical comparisons. Note: Full Team Analytics requires a free account.

faqs.question: What team metrics are available?
faqs.answer: Team Analytics includes runs scored/allowed, batting average, OPS, ERA, WHIP, fielding percentage, home/away splits, recent performance trends, and much more. Data is organized into offensive, pitching, and defensive categories.

faqs.question: Can I view historical team data?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can view team statistics across multiple seasons to analyze year-over-year trends, identify improvements or declines, and understand how teams have evolved over time.

faqs.question: Where can I see current MLB standings?
faqs.answer: Visit our MLB Standings page to view current division standings, wild card races, win-loss records, games behind leaders, and playoff positioning for all 30 teams organized by division. Standings are available to all users without an account.

faqs.question: How often are standings updated?
faqs.answer: Standings are updated regularly throughout the MLB season to reflect the most current records and playoff positioning for all teams.

faqs.question: Where does your data come from?
faqs.answer: We aggregate data from multiple reliable sources including official MLB statistics and advanced baseball metrics providers. All data is verified and cross-referenced to ensure accuracy.

faqs.question: What advanced metrics do you use?
faqs.answer: We utilize advanced sabermetrics including wOBA (Weighted On-Base Average), xFIP (Expected Fielding Independent Pitching), BABIP (Batting Average on Balls in Play), barrel rate, exit velocity, launch angle, and many others. Check our Glossary page for detailed explanations.

faqs.question: How often is your data updated?
faqs.answer: Statistical data is updated regularly throughout the MLB season after games conclude. We strive to provide the most current information available for your research and analysis.

faqs.question: I don't understand a statistic. Where can I learn more?
faqs.answer: Visit our Glossary page for comprehensive definitions and explanations of all baseball statistics and metrics used on our platform. Each term includes context for how to interpret and use the data effectively.

faqs.question: What educational content do you offer?
faqs.answer: We provide a detailed Glossary of baseball statistics, a Data Science section explaining our analytics methodology, informative blog posts, and Sandlot Insider articles with in-depth analysis and commentary.

faqs.question: Where can I read analysis articles?
faqs.answer: Check out our Sandlot Insider section for in-depth articles, player analysis, team breakdowns, and baseball commentary written by our team of analysts.

faqs.question: How can I improve my understanding of baseball analytics?
faqs.answer: Start with our Glossary to learn key terms, read our Data Science section to understand analytical methodology, explore our How To Use guide for tips on using our tools effectively, and dive into Sandlot Insider for applied analysis.

faqs.question: Is there a mobile app?
faqs.answer: Currently, we don't have a dedicated mobile app, but our website is fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices. You can access all features through your mobile browser with the same functionality as desktop.

faqs.question: I found a bug. How do I report it?
faqs.answer: We appreciate bug reports! Please use our Contact page and provide as much detail as possible including what you were doing, what went wrong, and any error messages you saw.

faqs.question: What browsers are supported?
faqs.answer: Our platform works best on modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge (latest versions). We recommend keeping your browser updated for the best experience and security.

faqs.question: Why isn't data showing for a player or team?
faqs.answer: Data may not show if the player is a recent call-up with limited MLB statistics, there's a temporary data sync issue, or the player is inactive. Try refreshing the page or check back later.

faqs.question: Will you add other sports?
faqs.answer: We're focused on perfecting our MLB analytics first. While we've designed our platform to be modular and scalable, we currently have no immediate plans to expand beyond baseball. Stay tuned to our announcements!

faqs.question: What new features are coming?
faqs.answer: We're continuously improving our platform with enhanced visualizations, additional statistics, more in-depth analysis tools, and expanded educational content. Follow our updates for the latest additions.

faqs.question: How is my data protected?
faqs.answer: We take privacy seriously. We don't collect unnecessary personal information, use industry-standard encryption, and never sell your data to third parties. Read our Privacy Policy for complete details on data handling and protection.

faqs.question: How can I contact support?
faqs.answer: You can reach us through our Contact page. We typically respond within 24-48 hours and appreciate your patience as we work to address all inquiries.

faqs.question: Can I provide feedback or suggest features?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We welcome feedback, feature requests, and suggestions. Use our Contact page to share your ideas. Your input helps us improve and build a better platform for the baseball community.
